verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents automatic import and categorization of bank transactions, and says its built-in AI handles categorizing bank statements. Nothing in the evidence shows these suggestions learn from user corrections. Bank Rules are user-defined rules, an adjacent control rather than learned behavior, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: evidence that categorization adapts or learns from user corrections, detail on how suggestions are presented and accepted, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections

citations.quote: Automatically import transactions, categorise them, and streamline the reconciliation process for swift month-end closing
categorizing bank statements, or building workflow Blueprints, AI in Zoho Books turns financial data into the next step automatically
